scope: 152 supplied GRONI death-index rows; Roberts excluded; rows with an already inspected original civil return excluded

ranked.question: Is this the Killycurragh David Glasgow born 1865, or a different Cookstown-area David?
ranked.why_full_return_might_resolve: Glasgow-1802 has a documented 1865 Killycurragh birth and no death. The return's informant, address, occupation and marital/parental context could connect the 1884 death to Killycurragh or exclude it; it is one side of the explicit Cookstown-versus-Omagh identity split.

excluded_notes: All rows assessed existing_profile or existing_profile_update were excluded where the maintained research already cites or inspected an original civil death return; a paid GRONI copy would add little to the stated brick-wall.
All deferred_robert rows were excluded per instruction.

Unmatched infants and generic no_catalogue_match rows were excluded because the supplied material does not document a specific parent, spouse, locality or identity-split question that a particular full return is likely to resolve.
